title: Aidan 的魔法方块世界
Aidan’s Magic Block World
heroTitle:
魔法，真的改变世界
Aidan · 两路重制准备

Magic that changes the world
Aidan · remake preparation
intro: 从自由建造，走到火焰、水与食物循环，再走进昼夜生态。这次先保存已经想清楚的规则，为 Opus 和 Astra 准备同一份重制需求；新版尚未制作。
From free building to fire, water and food, then day/night ecology. Preserve the rules already developed and prepare one shared brief for Opus and Astra. The remakes have not been built.

title: 把“不够好”说成可实现的缺口
Turn “not good enough” into a concrete gap
practice: “水里什么都没有”引出了水下生命和互动，而非盲目加方块。
“There is nothing in the water” led to aquatic life/interactions rather than more block types.
knowledge: 需求应描述缺失体验及可观察结果。
Requirements describe a missing experience and observable result.
expression: 我在……看到了……；我希望能做……，完成后应该看到……。
At … I observed …; I want to do … and then see ….
level: 来自仓库课堂纪要的复盘；不视为完整逐字稿或独立掌握证明。
Retrospective from repository lesson notes, not a complete transcript or proof of independent mastery.

title: 先问用途，再决定功能
Ask its purpose before adding a feature
practice: 讨论“挖穿基岩”时发现没有形成玩法目标，选择不做。
Bedrock digging had no gameplay purpose and was excluded.
knowledge: 范围控制：功能数量不等于玩法价值。
Scope control: feature count is not gameplay value.
expression: 这个功能让玩家做什么决定？不用它，会失去什么体验？
What decision does this feature create? What experience is lost without it?
level: 来自仓库课堂纪要的复盘；不视为完整逐字稿或独立掌握证明。
Retrospective from repository lesson notes, not a complete transcript or proof of independent mastery.

title: 资源状态接成闭环
Connect resource states into a loop
practice: 鱼从水里被抓到、放下、烤熟、拾取并食用。
Fish move from water to catch, placement, cooking, pickup and consumption.
knowledge: 状态转换与反馈必须一致；不能按钮变化却没有真实资源变化。
State transitions and feedback must agree; UI changes are not resource changes.
expression: 先得到A，把A通过B变成C；C如何帮助下一轮行动？
Obtain A, use B to turn it into C; how does C help the next action?
level: 来自仓库课堂纪要的复盘；不视为完整逐字稿或独立掌握证明。
Retrospective from repository lesson notes, not a complete transcript or proof of independent mastery.

title: 区分地形高度和可走的地面
Terrain height differs from walkable ground
practice: 代码记录树下生物会把树冠当脚下地面，后来修正行走判定。
The recorded bug treated treetops as ground beneath creatures; walking checks were revised.
knowledge: 边界条件、碰撞与导航；技术解释来自代码，不冒称课堂已全部教完。
Boundary conditions, collisions and navigation; this explanation comes from code, not a claim of full classroom mastery.
expression: 在什么位置会卡住？脚下是哪种方块？修完怎样证明没有回归？
Where does it get stuck, what block is underfoot, and how do we retest?
level: 来自仓库课堂纪要的复盘；不视为完整逐字稿或独立掌握证明。
Retrospective from repository lesson notes, not a complete transcript or proof of independent mastery.

overall_label: 三阶段总进度 · 里程碑口径
formula: 总进度 = (MVP完成率 + 资产完成率 + 发布运营准备完成率) ÷ 3。三个阶段等权；每阶段内部只数已完成的验收项。不表示工时、花费或日历时间占比。
